title: 第21章 发财第22章 百炼铜精
content_zh:
二狗子大步快走，赶到县城的时候，也到了傍晚时分。
进城的时候，他心中还有那么一丝占到便宜的得意。
刚才在路上，他没想到，天寒地冻的，山贼竟然也不在家里休息，还出来拦路抢劫。
虽说这伙山贼信用不错，但二狗子也不想平白无故地交几十文钱。
自己平时吃顿猪肉都抠抠搜搜，几十文钱能买一斤猪肉了。
于是，他趁这群山贼不备，突然一个加速就逃了。
他上次跟黑影比过脚力之后，对自己逃命的本事信心大涨。
特别是最近修炼又有进展，体内那一缕真气壮大好几倍，跑起来速度更快，耐力更持久。
他发力狂奔，那些山贼只剩下在后面吆喝的份，根本就追不上。
至于跟山贼拼命，他想都没想过，刀剑无眼，万一不小心在身上捅个窟窿就亏大了。
二狗子走进城门，县城里的乞丐更多了，一窝蜂全都涌了上来，把他围在中间。
刚开始他还有点犹豫不决，要不要像来福那样用鞭子抽。
但这些乞丐欺负他是乡巴佬，很多只手已经开始剥他衣服，抢他麻袋，连裤子上的绳子都被解开了。
“滚！”
二狗子一声大吼，手脚并用，蛮力使开，顿时围在周边的乞丐摔出去好几步远。
这下子没人再敢上前乞讨了，重新系好裤腰带，整理一下衣服，大步往前走去。
看来，对这些乞丐真不能忍让，不然连衣服都会被扒光。
回春堂的生意还是那么清冷，那名青年正在伏案看书。
当他听到脚步声抬头看到二狗子时，当即像被狗咬了一样，从椅子上蹦起。
“你终于来了！”

“我等得好辛苦啊！”
青年双手紧握住二狗子的手，显得极为激动。
见此，二狗子就已经猜到，大概是上一批大力丸已经用完了。
“你上次给我的那个大力丸还有吗？这次带了多少？”
青年没有掩饰自己对于那种药丸的渴望。
上次购买的那些大力丸，他本来打算留在店里治病救人用的。
被他一位练武的兄长发现，当成糖豆给吃完了。
这位兄长就天天缠着他要这种药丸，说是有奇效，对练武之人大有助益。
缠得他没办法，却又找不到二狗子的踪迹，只能干着急。
“你看，找不到你，我连头发都愁白了。”
青年扯着他一根白头发给二狗子看。
“带了一些。”
二狗子点了点头，心里却感觉这个青年比自己还大几岁，一点也不懂事。
把这么急切要买的想法都表露出来了，不怕自己到时候漫天要价。
他从小就知道，在集市里想买什么东西的时候，都要假装不喜欢，挑挑拣拣才好砍价。
可能人家从小就有吃有穿，根本就不用像自己这样小心翼翼。
content_en:
Ergouzi walked quickly and arrived at the county seat in the evening.
When he entered the city, he still felt a little proud of taking advantage.
On the road just now, he didn't expect that the bandits wouldn't rest at home due to the cold weather, and would even come out to block the road and rob him.
Although this group of bandits had good credit, Ergouzi didn't want to pay dozens of pennies for nothing.
I usually dig at the pork every time I eat, and I can buy a pound of pork for a few tens of pennies.
So, he took advantage of the bandits' unpreparedness and suddenly accelerated and fled.
After he compared his foot strength with the shadow last time, his confidence in his ability to escape has greatly increased.
Especially recently, there has been progress in cultivation. The ray of true energy in the body has grown several times, making the running faster and the endurance longer.
He ran as fast as he could, and the bandits could only shout from behind, unable to catch up.
As for fighting the bandits, he has never thought about it. The sword has no eyes, and he will suffer big losses if he accidentally pokes a hole in his body.
When Er Gouzi walked into the city gate, there were more beggars in the county. A swarm of bees swarmed up and surrounded him.
At first he was a little hesitant about whether to use a whip like Laifu.
But these beggars bullied him as a country bumpkin. Many hands had already begun to peel off his clothes, snatch his sack, and even untied the ropes on his pants.
"Get out!"
Ergouzi roared loudly and used his hands and feet to move away with brute force. The beggars surrounding him suddenly fell several steps away.
Now no one dared to come forward to beg. He tied his belt again, straightened his clothes, and strode forward.
It seemed that I really couldn't tolerate these beggars, otherwise I would even have my clothes stripped off.
The business of Huichun Hall was still so quiet, and the young man was reading a book at his desk.
When he heard the footsteps and looked up to see Er Gouzi, he immediately jumped up from his chair as if he had been bitten by a dog.
"You're finally here!"
"I've had such a hard time waiting!"
The young man held Er Gouzi's hand tightly with both hands, looking extremely excited.
Seeing this, Ergouzi had already guessed that the last batch of Dali Pills had probably been used up.
"Do you still have the powerful pill you gave me last time? How many did you bring this time?"
The young man did not hide his desire for that pill.
He originally planned to keep the Dali Pills he bought last time in the store to treat illnesses and save lives.
He was discovered by one of his brothers who practiced martial arts and ate it as a jelly bean.
This brother kept pestering him for this pill every day, saying it had miraculous effects and would be of great help to those practicing martial arts.
He was so pestered that he had no choice but to find no trace of Er Gouzi, so he could only worry.
"Look, I can't find you, and even my hair has turned gray."
The young man pulled a piece of his white hair to show Er Gouzi.
"Bring some."
Er Gouzi nodded, feeling in his heart that this young man was several years older than him and was not sensible at all.
I have expressed my eagerness to buy it, and I am not afraid that I will ask for an exorbitant price when the time comes.
He has known since he was a child that when he wanted to buy something in the market, he had to pretend not to like it and pick and choose in order to bargain.
Maybe people have had food and clothing since they were young, so they don't need to be as cautious as I am.
